description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the 4×4 Switch Sensor for the 1985 – 1995 Samurai and SJ413.
Screws into the Transfer Case.
This switch activates the 4 Wheel Drive Indicator Light located in the Instrument Cluster
Inexpensive and easy to install.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – 4×4 Switch Sensor (Round Plug)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
